People: Georg Hartwig (author, Wikidata Q78102638), died 1880. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Hartwig, G. (Georg), 1813-1880") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The sea and its living wonders; a popular account of the marvels of the deep and of the progress of maritime discovery from the earliest ages to the present time, London, New York, Longmans, Green, and co., 1892, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/seaitslivingwond00hart.
